title: Heritage Hill Banquets

services.name: Event Venue Rental
services.desc: Restored and added onto over an 11 year period from the 1970's. Heritage Hill is a beautiful banquet facility for weddings, receptions, corporate events, birthday parties, wine tastings, or anything you might need a stunning banquet facility for! We have a 35 foot deck and 14 foot diameter gazebo for an outdoor setting if that's what you prefer. Our reception hall has capacity to seat 140 people inside and during the summer months up to 160 by allowing the party to spill out onto the deck. Included in the price are 10 six place tables, food tables, bar table, gift table, cake table, all with linens and centerpieces. Deck has tables and chairs in warm weather only. No caterers fees.
